title: Learner clarity pass - targeted teaching fixes after direct Class-10 learner review
statusReason: All five learner stumbling points and the timing problem are resolved in the shipped content and the running build, each one held by a test. The pedagogical spine, the Explore system and the validated elbow are unchanged.

baseline.step15aPackage: qa/expert/step15/ - left untouched; it describes the previous candidate

fixes.issue: The same reviewer-language disclaimer appeared under 19 of 38 captions
fixes.resolution: Said once instead: a persistent on-stage status while indicators are visible, one plain line on entering a teaching-simulation exploration, and the full technical wording in the Sources & draft status dialog

fixes.issue: Three anatomical names introduced in one sentence
fixes.before: At the elbow, the humerus meets the radius and the ulna.
fixes.after: The elbow is where the upper-arm bone meets two bones in the forearm.
fixes.namesRetainedOn: the anchor labels already on the model in that shot (Humerus, Radius, Ulna)

fixes.issue: "Axis" used twice before it was ever explained
fixes.resolution: The pivot chapter no longer uses the word; it is introduced once, in the shot that shows the blue line, explained before it is named
fixes.after: This blue line shows the direction the elbow bends around. We call that line the axis.

fixes.issue: The pivot chapter showed rotation but never showed one bone turning around another
fixes.resolution: A new beat looks at the two neck bones with nothing moving, from behind and level, then the rotation beat pulls back so the head is in frame; framing chosen by comparing eight rendered candidates

fixes.issue: Flexion and extension were named and never used again
~5.5 s of silence around 3:04 that read as a stall
fixes.rootCause: hinge.return is a deliberate transition with real motion (camera 0-1.5 s, elbow 0.9-4.2 s) but had no caption at all, so the narration builder produced no clip for it - and its last 1.3 s was a static frame with no text and no audio
fixes.resolution: Kept as a transition; it now says what it is doing (which gives it a narration clip) and the dead tail is trimmed to where the motion ends
fixes.separateEnvironmentNote: Playback also crawls while the desktop Browser pane is hidden, because the browser throttles animation frames for an occluded tab and the film clock rides the render loop. That is environment behaviour, not this defect.
